notes:
Account snapshot: Alpenglow builds an omnichannel support platform for mid-market retail brands. Primary need: post-call summarization + QA analytics + agent coaching highlights; secondary: automatic ticket creation (tool-calling into Zendesk/SFDC) and real-time agent assist snippets.

Customer constraints / priorities (from calls):
- Must support high-volume spikes (Black Friday/holiday): currently see 3x baseline call volume, want platform to sustain 3x spikes without manual scaling.
- POC success metrics: generate accurate post-call summaries within <=5s (95th percentile), QA extraction (issue tags, compliance flags) >90% recall on curated eval set, and end-to-end cost per call target ~$0.03.
- Security: SOC2 required; SSO/SAML for agent console; audit logging retained 1 year; EU data residency for EU merchants. KMS for keys.

Integrations: Zendesk (ticket creation + custom fields), Salesforce (case updates), internal voice-store (S3 transcripts). Want webhook tool-calling to run: update ticket, append summary, trigger coaching workflow.

Technical notes / preferences:
- Prefers a model routing strategy: local cheaper model for simple summaries, fallback to larger model for compliance-sensitive calls.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching config for peak windows, KV caching for repeated customer context, quantization profiles to reduce cost.
- Concern: cold-start latency for short calls; needs fast warm paths / prefetching of KV for returning customers.

Quotes / sales snippets:
- "If you can keep summaries under 5s and the cost goal, we'll move to dedicated capacity." — Head of Product
- "We need transparent token-level cost breakdowns for each route — legal will not sign blind pricing." — VP Ops

POC plan (agreed):
1) Redwood to receive 2 weeks of redacted transcripts (approx 10k calls) + current QA rubric; run baseline on hosted API.
2) Measure latency distribution, token cost, and accuracy vs rubric.
3) Execute 2 controlled spike tests (x2 and x3 baseline) to validate autoscaling / fallback policies.
4) Deliver report + recommended Dedicated config and Optimize tuning.

- How is KV caching billed when warm caches are shared across customers on hosted plan?
- Need sample SLA language for EU data residency in contract addendum.
